name: Tryo Chat — Chatbot for WooCommerce
author: tryosoft

sections.description:
Most shoppers who open a chat window ask the same few things: Where is my order? Can I return this? Do you have it in my size? Tryo Chat answers those questions instantly from your own FAQ, lets visitors search your products and add them to the cart without leaving the chat, and hands everything else to you as a support request in your inbox.

It works the moment you activate it. There is no account to create, no API key, no monthly fee and no third-party service: everything runs inside your WordPress site.

What your visitors get

  • Instant answers. Typed questions are matched against your FAQ, so “how can I track my order?” gets your tracking answer right away.
  • Product search in the chat. Results show the image, price and an Add to Cart button. Variable products link to their product page so the shopper can pick options.
  • A cart that stays in the conversation. Add items, change quantities, remove items and go to checkout from the chat window.
  • Showcase. One tap lists your on-sale or featured products.
  • A way to reach you. If the bot can’t help, the visitor leaves their name, email and message, optionally with an image or PDF.
  • Custom forms. Build simple multi-step forms (text, email, number, select) for quotes, wholesale requests or anything else.

What you get

  • A setup that takes minutes. A Getting started checklist on the dashboard walks you through the FAQ, colors and notification email.
  • Searches with no results. See what shoppers looked for but couldn’t find: the products to stock next, or the words to add to your product titles.
  • Support requests and form submissions in one place, emailed to you and exportable as CSV.
  • No inbox flooding. Email alerts for missed searches are off by default and limited to one per search term per day.
  • Your brand. Primary color, light or dark theme, left or right position, your own icon, bot name, welcome message and subtitle, with a live preview.
  • Control over where it appears. Show or hide the widget on specific URLs, on mobile or on desktop, and open it from any link or button with data-tryochat-open.
  • Export and import of settings and FAQs as JSON, so you can move them between sites.

Built to stay out of the way

  • About 12 KB of JavaScript and CSS (gzipped). No jQuery, no external scripts, no fonts or tracking loaded from other servers.
  • Works with page-cache plugins: the widget refreshes its security token by itself, so it keeps working on cached pages.
  • “Powered by Tryo Chat” is off by default.
  • Translated into English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese and Dutch.

Tryo Chat Pro

Need more than preset answers? Tryo Chat Pro adds AI chat (OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, Grok, Dialogflow) trained on your own pages and PDFs, a bargaining bot that wins back abandoned carts with automatic coupons, live chat hand-off to your team, WhatsApp / Telegram / Messenger buttons and proactive retargeting messages. The free version stays fully usable on its own.
sections.installation:
1. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  2. In WordPress, go to Plugins → Add New, search for Tryo Chat and click Install Now, then Activate.
  3. Open Tryo Chat in the admin menu and follow the Getting started checklist: replace the sample FAQ answers with your own, pick your colors and check the notification email.
  4. Visit your shop: the chat button is already in the bottom corner.
sections.faq:
Does it use AI or need an API key?

No. The free version answers from the FAQ you write and from your WooCommerce product catalog. Nothing is sent to an outside service. AI answers are available in Tryo Chat Pro.

Is this a live chat?

Not in the free version. Visitors get instant answers from your FAQ and products, and anything else comes to you as an email (a support request) that you reply to as usual. Live hand-off to a human agent is part of Tryo Chat Pro.

How does it answer a typed question?

When a visitor types instead of tapping a button, Tryo Chat compares the words with your FAQ questions. If one clearly matches, it shows that answer. If not, it searches your products. If that finds nothing either, it offers the FAQ list or a support request. Writing FAQ questions the way customers would ask them gives the best results.

Will it slow down my store?

The widget loads one small script and one stylesheet (about 12 KB gzipped together) and makes no requests until a visitor opens it.

Does it work with caching plugins like WP Rocket or LiteSpeed Cache?

Yes. If a cached page carries an expired security token, the widget fetches a fresh one and retries automatically.

Why am I getting “Searched product not found” emails?

Only if you turned on Also email me when a product search finds nothing under General → Notifications. Each search term triggers at most one email per day. Every missed search is listed on the Dashboard either way.

Can I open the chat from my own button or link?

Yes. Add the data-tryochat-open attribute to any element, for example <a href="#" data-tryochat-open>Chat with us</a>.

What data does the plugin store? Is it GDPR friendly?

Support requests and form submissions are stored in your own WordPress database with the visitor’s name, email, message, page URL, IP address and browser. Files attached by visitors (images or PDF, up to 5 MB) are saved in your uploads folder. Nothing is shared with third parties. Mention this in your privacy policy, and use Support Requests and Forms in the admin to delete records when asked.

Can I hide the widget on some pages?

Yes. Under General → Smart Visibility, list URL fragments such as /checkout and choose to show the widget only there or everywhere except there. You can also hide it on mobile or desktop.

Is it translated into my language?

The plugin ships with English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese and Dutch. You can help translate it into other languages on translate.wordpress.org.
sections.changelog:
2.2.1

  • Changed: General settings follow the new design: each switch explains what it does, the widget on/off switch sits on the Core Configuration card, and the visibility rule is a segmented control.
  • Changed: the chat header shows a friendly bot avatar when no custom icon is set.
  • New: Settings, Docs and Upgrade links on the Plugins screen.
  • New: declared compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage and the Cart/Checkout blocks.
  • New: add-ons can give their menu buttons an icon.
  • Fixed: clicking a panel tab left a dark focus frame around it; tabs now cross-fade instead of flashing.
  • Fixed: the plugin description on the Plugins screen still said “live chat”.
  • Fixed: a custom icon URL in the chat header wasn’t HTML-escaped.

2.2.0

  • New: typed questions are answered from your FAQ first, then from product search, then with a choice of FAQ or support request, instead of always running a product search.
  • New: Searches with no results list on the Dashboard.
  • New: Getting started checklist on the Dashboard.
  • New: FAQ questions can be edited. Before, the only way to change one was to delete it and add it again.
  • New: header subtitle setting, replacing the fixed “We usually reply within a few minutes” text.
  • New: German, French, Spanish, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese and Dutch translations.
  • Changed: “product not found” emails are now off by default, and limited to one per search term per day when turned on.
  • Changed: the widget design is refreshed. Quick actions wrap to fit their labels, and the widget shows a date line, a cleaner cart view and better contrast in the dark theme.
  • Changed: the admin panel is redesigned, with page titles and save buttons at the top of each screen, a clearer sidebar, and the FAQ list shown as a sortable table.
  • Changed: the Pro preview tabs no longer appear in the WordPress admin menu.
  • Fixed: the widget stopped working on cached pages once the page’s security token expired.
  • Fixed: “Powered by Tryo Chat” was shown even when turned off.
  • Fixed: a “translation loading triggered too early” notice on WordPress 6.7 and later.
  • Fixed: the typing indicator could stay on forever after a network error.
  • Fixed: the upload rate limit could be bypassed with a forged X-Forwarded-For header.
  • Fixed: the appearance preview showed a broken image when no custom icon was set.
  • Fixed: the Dashboard’s “New / unread” count never went down. Opening Support Requests now marks the requests shown as read, with a “New” badge on that first view.
  • Fixed: exporting settings dropped FAQ categories, so imported FAQs lost them.

2.1.0

  • New: the Pro-only feature areas (AI Chat, Knowledge Base, GPT Modules, Bargaining Bot, Live Chat, Multi-Channel, Retargeting) now appear in the admin panel as tabs with a “PRO” badge. Each shows what the feature does and a link to upgrade. They keep no settings and store no data, and are replaced by the real feature screens when Tryo Chat Pro is installed.
  • Updated the bundled Turkish translation.

2.0.0

  • The plugin’s default language is now English. Turkish ships as a bundled translation, so Turkish-language sites look exactly as before.
  • Fixed the three quick-action buttons on the Dashboard tab, which linked to the wrong page.
  • Renamed the “Panel” tab to “Dashboard”.

1.5.0

  • Added a bundled English translation, so English-language sites show the English interface with no extra plugin.

1.4.2

  • Security: added per-IP rate limiting to the file-attachment upload endpoint, and hardened validation of the primary colour value used by the settings importer.

1.4.0

  • Added close and “reset chat” buttons to the widget header.
  • Added file attachments (image / PDF) to the message composer.
  • Added quantity +/- controls to the cart view.

1.2.0

  • Removed the free-form “Custom CSS” field from the Appearance tab.
  • The “Powered by Tryo Chat” credit is now off by default and opt-in from the General tab.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: chat widget with product search, FAQ and a support request form; WooCommerce integration (add to cart, cart view, featured/on-sale showcase); smart URL-based visibility; settings and FAQ import/export; white-label option; and a simple multi-form builder.
